objective: Estimate the local fixed-route correctness and cost of FP32 Grug expert-output accumulation without changing the failed distributed gate or MarinSkyRL PR 276.

correctness.execution: GPU 0 only; parent then candidate in fresh processes; performance starts only if every gate passes
correctness.multiplication: BF16 expert output times combine weight cast to BF16, before either accumulator

oracles.fp32: independent slot-wise FP32 reduction from the path-specific BF16 weighted summands
oracles.fp64: independent fixed slot-order FP64 reduction from the same path-specific BF16 weighted summands

required_gates: parent eager and grouped outputs differ from the FP32 slot-wise contract
candidate eager and grouped outputs exactly match the FP32 slot-wise contract
candidate combine-relevant gradients match the FP32 and FP64 references within the frozen tolerance
candidate eager and grouped outputs match exactly and gradients match within the frozen tolerance
candidate maximum pre-cast error versus FP64 is lower than the parent's on eager and grouped paths

performance.state_initialization: deterministic BF16 normal(mean=0,std=0.02) in sorted parameter-name order
performance.input_initialization: deterministic BF16 normal with CUDA generator seed 20260806
performance.fixed_route: expert_id[token,slot] = (token * 73 + [0,1,7,31][slot]) mod 256; exactly 128 routed rows per expert
performance.combine_weights: deterministic FP32 sigmoid phases normalized to sum 2.5 per token
performance.source_isolation: fresh child process per arm/GPU/repetition; a copied common package differs only at the hash-checked accumulation blocks

boundaries.full_block: GrugMoeSparseMoeBlock._forward_grouped with routes fixed outside the router: route sorting, routed-input construction, grouped expert projections, BF16 weighting, combine accumulation, and backward
boundaries.combine: complete affected combine section: weight flatten/index-select/cast, BF16 expert-output multiplication, output allocation, index_add accumulation, candidate casts, and backward

performance.timing: CUDA events around forward and backward with backward-event synchronization; setup and gradient clearing are outside timed regions
performance.hbm: after warmup and gradient clearing, empty allocator cache, synchronize, record allocated baseline, reset peak stats, run measured iterations, report peak allocated and peak-minus-baseline
performance.pairing: both arms run twice on every physical GPU in alternating order; summarize 40 timing samples per arm/GPU, then report candidate-parent per-GPU deltas and cross-GPU median/range

forbidden: local EP=8 x FSDP=4 or any 32-worker smoke test

verdict.primary_metric: warmed full fixed-route sparse-block forward-plus-backward milliseconds
verdict.direction_rule: all eight per-GPU median deltas must have one sign to label that direction; otherwise report inconclusive direction
interpretation_limits: does not change the failed 32-H100 distributed action-output gate
does not prove distributed semantic equivalence or end-to-end MFU
does not identify attention as causal or resolve Marin issue 7903
does not put fbb1fc8 on MarinSkyRL PR 276
